asr_text: Your sip calls to 11 labs keep failing, check the URI. The common mistake, calling the domain with no identifier before the at sign. The fix put a phone number in E164 format before it. The identifier can also be any string, like 1 ,000 or John. And match the leading plus on both sides, or calls route wrong. TCP uses port 5 ,060 TLS uses 5 ,061. UDP is for testing only.
